purpose: 便捷转接底板：FPGA J13/J9、ESP32-C3、三块 MPR121、AHCT125/WS2812 接口

J_FPGA_J13.purpose: FPGA dock J13; mating orientation and clearance pending

physicalVerification.mprModulePinOrder: Unverified; do not mate modules directly using logical harness order. Generated annotation images are not manufacturing evidence.
physicalVerification.c3: GPIO7/GPIO6/GND are separate board locations; J_C3 is a harness interface, not a direct C3 socket.
physicalVerification.fpga: J13 is 2x20 2.54mm; connector pin-1 view, socket mounting side and component clearance still need verification.
physicalVerification.ahct: Existing board uses separate 2P J1 signal and 2P J3 power connectors.

rules: MPR1/2/3 SCL and SDA remain three separate buses
MPR ADD pins all connect to GND for address 0x5A
5V_AUX never connects to FPGA J13/J9 logic power
J13-11 and J13-15 through J13-40 remain NC
AHCT DATA/GND go only to existing J1; auxiliary 5V/GND go separately to J3
C3 uses GPIO7 TX and GPIO6 RX, not the C3 silk TX/RX pins
